reason: VibeMeter is a macOS monitoring and visualization application that observes local AI coding agent activity, aggregates usage analytics, and presents status updates, notifications, history, and shareable reports without controlling agents or modifying source repositories.

summaries.zh: VibeMeter 是一款 macOS 应用，用于监测本地 AI 编程 Agent 活动、汇总使用数据并展示实时状态、通知、历史分析和可分享报告。
summaries.en: VibeMeter is a macOS app that monitors local AI coding agent activity, aggregates usage data, and presents real-time status, notifications, historical analysis, and shareable reports.

capabilities: Monitors local AI coding agent activity and session events
Reads supported local session history and derives usage, token, cost, tool, model, and activity metrics
Installs or manages local hooks for supported agents
Stores derived analytics in a local database
Displays desktop and menu bar status views and system notifications
